title: The Next Phase of AI Drug Development: Making Molecules Survive as Drugs
summary: AI drug development is moving from molecular generation to clinical survival. AnHorn Medicines shows how AI+PROTAC, experimental feedback, and human translation may form a Taiwan-born clinical-asset engine.
imageAlt: AI drug development clinical asset engine cover

title: Where Does AI Drug Discovery Stand Now? A Pipeline-Based Reality Check
summary: AI drug discovery has moved beyond the concept stage and into clinical validation. This article reviews Zasocitinib, GB-0895, Zovegalisib, and REC-4881 to examine how different AI strategies are being converted into real drug assets.
